title: Automotive Data Engineer / Vehicle Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description:

title: Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform)
description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.
Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.
UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.
 About the role The Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform) will design, build and operate the data platform that makes UFORCE’s operational data usable for AI model training and validation.
 You will connect diverse data sources—from high-frequency telemetry and time series to imagery, video, documents and structured records—and make the resulting data discoverable, governed and reproducible. You will work hands-on across architecture, pipelines, data quality and platform operations, while helping other engineers and partner teams make sound technical decisions.
 This is a staff-level individual contributor role for someone who combines strong engineering judgment with a practical approach to delivery. You will partner with ML, product, engineering, field and security teams to build a platform that works for real use cases and operating constraints. Model research and model performance decisions remain with the accountable ML and product owners.
 What you’ll do Design and deliver a data platform for ingesting, storing, discovering and preparing heterogeneous data for approved analytics and ML workflows.

title: Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark based in Netherlands.
 We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable, reliable data integration solutions in a fully remote European environment.
You will build and optimise modern ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
Working extensively with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake, you will contribute to robust, high-performing data platforms.
The role combines hands-on engineering, data modelling, automation and production support.
You will collaborate with data analysts, reporting specialists and software developers to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
This is an opportunity to apply modern cloud data engineering practices, improve data quality and contribute to the evolution of enterprise data solutions.
 Accountabilities
 Design, develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
 Build, optimise and maintain data processing workflows using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows.
 Develop and manage data pipelines using Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, formerly Delta Live Tables, and organise data assets through Unity Catalog.
 Design and optimise SQL queries, data transformations and dimensional data models to improve processing efficiency and data accessibility.
 Integrate data from APIs, files and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, working with formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON.
 Implement automated testing and quality assurance processes, debug issues and troubleshoot production pipelines to ensure data accuracy and reliability.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 Discord is looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and help build the trusted data foundations that power decisions across the company. Data Engineering is the foundational layer between Discord's raw data and the teams that depend on it: Data Science, ML, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders. You'll design, build, and maintain clean, tested, well-documented datasets that those teams can discover, trust, and self-serve from.
 You'll join one of two squads, Gaming or Ads , working alongside experienced data engineers and data scientists. This is a growth role: you'll take on well-scoped problems with guidance from senior teammates, and build toward owning a data domain end to end.
 If you enjoy data modeling, SQL, and making reliable data easy for other teams to use, read on.
 What You Will Be Doing
 Build and maintain well-modeled, tested, and documented datasets in BigQuery using dbt, with guidance from senior data engineers
 Take ownership of scoped pipelines, tables, and metric improvements within your squad, from requirements through delivery and documentation
 Write accurate, efficient SQL and Python to transform structured and unstructured data into curated datasets for analytics, experimentation, and ML
 Improve the reliability, freshness, and quality of existing datasets by adding tests, monitoring, and documentation
 Partner with data scientists, product managers, and engineers to turn clear requests into concrete data models, and ask good questions when requests are ambiguous
